question: Should this issue remain the canonical Wave 2 task for bundled dashboard agent activity/status widgets, or should the remaining work be folded into the broader per-session activity contract?
rationale: The request is coherent, but current main lacks the dashboard plugin foundation and the durable activity/attention contract, so maintainers need to choose sequencing and ownership before implementation.

options.title: Keep as staged dashboard builtin task
options.body: Keep this issue open as the presentation-layer task, sequenced after the Wave 1 dashboard foundation and per-session activity contract are accepted.

options.title: Fold into backend activity contract
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 own the remaining semantics first, then reopen or split a narrower widget-only issue after that lands.

options.title: Redirect to external plugin later
options.body: If bundled dashboard builtins are not desired, defer this until the widget SDK can support an external plugin implementation.

recommendation.title: Keep as staged dashboard builtin task
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the presentation-layer task, sequenced after the Wave 1 dashboard foundation and per-session activity contract are accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger is the strongest current-main routing signal for the Control UI/session presentation surface, while Vincent Koc remains important for the backend activity contract.
